meanings.meaning: A person from the tribe of Ephraim, one of the tribes of Israel. Ephraimites are also sometimes called Ephrathites.
In one place, the phrase "leaders of the Ephraimites" refers to the leaders of Israel's northern kingdom.

problems.problem: Meaning 2 still says “Ephraimites” means the rulers, rather than explaining that “leaders of the Ephraimites” refers to the rulers of the northern kingdom.
